sentence: This project builds visual computing algorithms whose internal parameters can be tuned automatically with deep learning and data.
This project builds a digital learning tool that uses natural language processing to prompt written reflections on learning in large lecture courses.
This project tries to build a community of microorganisms that turns waste into biogas by feeding on electricity whose direction is switched.
This project studies theories about dark matter and cosmic inflation that go beyond the standard model of particle physics.
This project develops decentralized manifold optimization methods for multi-agent systems that work in dynamic environments.
This project builds tools to find and repair memory safety flaws in graphics processing unit software and adds defenses against memory attacks.
This project builds partnerships that help research groups in geoscience and engineering use advanced computing tools such as cloud workflows.
This project makes iron compounds with redox-active ligands and studies how spin and charge interact in them.
This project builds statistical tests that need no assumption about how data are distributed and models dependence in network data.
This project tests portable carts of hands-on making activities that teach young children computational thinking through culturally linked weaving patterns.
This project brings artificial intelligence into sensing systems that keep track of health and biological systems and their resilience.
This project studies how metal oxide nanoparticles used as contrast agents for magnetic resonance imaging affect neutrophils and platelets in the blood.
This project builds computer methods that use quantum computing and machine learning to predict the energies and properties of molecules and materials.
This project builds statistical tests that check whether copula models fit data on event timing when some events are not fully observed.
This project brings together researchers to present work on computational number theory, cryptography, and related fields.
This project builds artificial intelligence tools that use sensors and drones to warn farmers early about crop pests, diseases, and water shortages.
